decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core range costs little to keep on existing production lines, and no evidence shows its value has failed, so the option is still worth holding.
A sweet pastry that fits the established assortment carries low cost, and with no negative signal, keeping it preserves its option value.
A crusty farmhouse bread shares existing ingredients and craft processes, so carrying it is cheap while its prospects remain open.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship seasonal product whose value has resolved positively, which justifies further commitment.
The gold-awarded premium stollen shows realized quality value and needs only seasonal production capacity, so keeping it is clearly worthwhile.
